'''Gibbons''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] he traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] opposing the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], assigned to the Military branch of the Alliance under Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo]].<ref>{{TORcite|Knights of the Fallen Empire|Odessen}}</ref>
